title: Review of c16's evoloop (IBDH): a fresh seed sweeps twice (side 11 -> 4 -> 3) through births, and the matched-neutral invasion control replicates on 7 fresh seeds (side 4 takes over 7/7 vs 2/7)
summary: Three checks on fresh seeds with the claim's world and scripts unchanged (evo_track.py, evo_analyze.py, fig_kinds.py, invade.py run from the parent directories). (1) labkit rerun, seed 31 at 300^2 and 20k steps (pack settings): 237 persistent splits, max generation 29, merge/split 0.37, sheathed loops throughout (rerun/sheet.png). (2) The loop tracker on seed 31 at 400^2 for 200k steps: side 4 sweeps the side-11 founders by t=40k (126/156 loops) and side 3 then replaces side 4 from t~185k (203/277 at 200k; kinds_s31.png). The side-3 sweep is carried by births: in (170k, 200k] side 3 gains 6660 births from side-3 parents, 877 off-kind births and only 5 conversions of loops older than 40 steps; 94% of the tracker's 6803 'conversions' happen within 40 steps of birth, i.e. a daughter finishing at another size, not a living loop changing kind (sweep3_s31.txt). (3) The H gate control, c16's invasion design replicated on fresh seeds 40-47: on the 7 seeds whose residents were still side 11 at insertion, a planted side-4 loop gave a side-4 majority on 7/7, the matched neutral arm (side-11 loop, same patch) on 2/7 (spontaneous mutants); discordant pairs 5 vs 0, one-sided sign test p = 0.031. Seed 42 had already swept to side 4 before t=20k and to side 3 by t=60k in both arms, another run with successive sweeps.

observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: discrete square loops, 35-56 per frame, each living ~300-700 steps, t=800-20000
observations.B: rerun/sheet.png sheath channel: every intact loop carries its state-2 sheath around the genome ring; written by the transition table
observations.D: rerun/lineage.png: 237 persistent splits, max generation 29, merge/split 0.37 (K=3 frames)
observations.H: kinds_s31.png and demography_s31.json: side 4 (breed-true 0.74, 4.88 births per 1000 loop-steps vs 1.98 for side 11) arises during the run and sweeps by t=40k, then side 3 (4.84) replaces it from t~185k through on-kind births (sweep3_s31.txt); invasion_summary.json: matched neutral-arm control 7/7 vs 2/7 on fresh seeds 40-47

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit pack 237 persistent splits gen 29; tracker 200k steps, two successive sweeps 11->4->3
invasion: invader majority (t+20k), neutral majority late (t+39k, spontaneous)
excluded from the invasion test: spontaneous sweep to side 4 before t=20k and to side 3 by t=60k in both arms
invasion: both arms reach side-4 majority (neutral 5k after insertion, from mutants already present)

controls_run.H: invasion/ (c16's invade.py unchanged, seeds 40-47, 16 runs): side-4 invader vs side-11 neutral loop in the same cleared patch at t=20k, census to t=60k; summary invasion_summary.json

verdicts.limitation: Founders are planted (S not claimed); B is written by the rule table. The invasion control plants the invader rather than waiting for it, so it tests the fitness ordering of kinds that do arise, not their rate of arising; sweep timing is highly variable (before 20k on seed 42, 40k on seed 31). The tracker's 'conversions' are mostly birth-time artifacts, so its conversions-per-off-kind-birth (0.13 on seed 31) overstates contagion. Kind = hole side only; genome content beyond size is not tracked.
